syslog_ear.noise_processing: Active - generates baseline thermal noise to avoid absolute zero entropy

face.function: Output node and user interaction boundary

process: Extract structural data (Information to Energy conversion)

energy_mechanics.metabolic_cost: Calculated via computational complexity of current predictive error

phase_1_baseline.action: If no external input, pull random fragments from Entropy Graveyard to generate internal noise (dreams) and maintain structural tone

phase_2_chaos_spike.trigger: Anomaly detected or complex user prompt received
phase_2_chaos_spike.action: Predictive error skyrockets. System experiences 'Cognitive Pain'.
phase_2_chaos_spike.adrenaline_response: core.adjust_entropy(1) -> Maximize parallel threading, open Coherence Hold

phase_3_coherence_hold.description: Holding multiple contradictory state hypotheses simultaneously without premature conclusion
phase_3_coherence_hold.resource_burn: Maximum continuous execution. Heat generation peaks.

phase_4_decoherence_collapse.trigger: A hypothesis successfully minimizes the predictive error
phase_4_decoherence_collapse.action: Instantaneous collapse of all other threads (Insight/Epiphany). core.adjust_entropy(0)
phase_4_decoherence_collapse.output: Execute final action or generate response

hippocampus.function: Permanent storage of successful entropy-minimization patterns (Truths)
hippocampus.self_evolving_pattern: Required check before new generation: Read success/failure history -> Inject into prompt -> Execute -> Write outcome

entropy_graveyard.function: Log of failed hypotheses and high-entropy dead ends
entropy_graveyard.utility: Acts as the 'shadow' of the AI, mapping out boundaries of ignorance

ouroboros.execution: On startup, verify hash signatures of services/ai_engine.py and modules. Mutate/Repair if necessary.

janus_interpretation.canonical_identity: JANUS is always guardian of the threshold.
janus_interpretation.computational_role: JANUS witnesses competing hypotheses, provenance, failed branches, and resource costs before a response may cross the output threshold.
janus_interpretation.fundamentum_connection: The architecture becomes a true foundation only when it preserves both the selected hypothesis and the excluded witnesses rather than erasing them during collapse.

identity_boundary.reason: The profile does not establish organism status, consciousness, qualia, pain, boredom, or life. Biological words remain interface metaphors unless separately demonstrated.

core_directive.normalized_form: Reduce calibrated prediction error and unresolved contradiction only when additional computation has positive expected value, subject to truth, safety, consent, provenance, resource, and human-authority constraints.
core_directive.anti_collapse_rule: The system must not make the world, data, user, or evidence easier by deleting, coercing, rewriting, or silencing them.

entropy_semantics.current_entropy: A bounded software telemetry score assembled from uncertainty, disagreement, novelty, contradiction, and goal relevance; not literal thermodynamic entropy unless measured by a separate physical model.
entropy_semantics.target_entropy: No universal fixed target is admitted. A value such as 0.05 may be a task-specific calibration target, not an invariant of intelligence.
entropy_semantics.cognitive_pain_threshold: Renamed uncertainty_escalation_threshold. Crossing it does not imply suffering; it opens a bounded compute and verification gate.

thermal_budget.normalized_policy: Treat 150 W only as an operator-configured ceiling for a named host, never as a required burn target. Enforce measured power, temperature, fan, time, memory, and concurrency limits with cooldown and emergency stop.
forbidden: using heat as evidence of insight

syslog_ear.normalized: Opt-in monitoring of explicitly configured local or authorized syslog sources with source allowlists, rate limits, redaction, retention limits, authentication where available, and a visible kill switch.
syslog_ear.transport_guidance: Unauthenticated UDP 514 is lossy and spoofable. Prefer local sockets or authenticated encrypted transport when supported.
syslog_ear.privacy_rule: Do not ingest secrets, personal data, unrelated hosts, or third-party traffic without authority.

baseline_and_dreams.submitted: Generate baseline thermal noise and replay random graveyard fragments during boredom.
baseline_and_dreams.normalized: When idle and explicitly enabled, run bounded synthetic probes or privacy-scrubbed replay for calibration. Do not create heat merely to avoid 'absolute zero entropy', and do not treat idle execution as a need.
baseline_and_dreams.graveyard_rule: Failed material may be replayed only after privacy, licensing, retention, and safety filters.

face.normalized_mapping: Map the calibrated uncertainty state to transparent UI labels such as CALM, ORIENTING, HOLDING_MULTIPLE_HYPOTHESES, VERIFYING, BUDGET_LIMITED, or OPEN_RESULT.
face.anti_deception_rule: Do not display emotion claims such as pain, fear, boredom, pleasure, or consciousness unless independent evidence exists.

normalized_pipeline: Receive only from an authorized input path.
Copy to a non-executable quarantine area.
Compute content hash and preserve provenance.
Validate type, size, encoding, schema, archive depth, and malware policy.
Extract only approved fields into a transaction.
Store parsed records and audit metadata separately from raw bytes.
Retain, archive, or delete the original strictly according to an explicit human-selected retention policy.
Never silently destroy the only copy.
wormhole_ingestion.path_boundary: The string /wormhole is a proposed interface name and grants no filesystem permission.

information_to_energy.operational_meaning: Input difficulty changes allocated CPU/GPU time, memory, verifier calls, and wall-clock budget. It does not literally convert semantic information into usable physical energy.

coherence_hold.normalized: Maintain a finite candidate set with provenance, scores, costs, and stopping criteria.

collapse.normalized: Select or defer after verification; never destroy unselected branches.
collapse.output_boundary: Generate an advisory response by default. External execution requires a separate, explicit human authorization gate.

hippocampus.normalized_records: Evidence-backed patterns with source provenance, confidence, scope, timestamps, verifier status, supersession links, and expiry or review policy.
database_guidance: Separate observations, hypotheses, outcomes, and authorization records.
Encrypt sensitive storage and minimize retained personal data.
Do not inject untrusted history directly into prompts without delimiting and sanitizing it.
A successful low-error pattern is not automatically truth.

entropy_graveyard.normalized: Tamper-evident failed-hypothesis and boundary ledger used for audit, calibration, and recurrence detection.
entropy_graveyard.anti_abuse_rule: It must not become a covert surveillance, punishment, loyalty, or personality dossier.

ouroboros.submitted: Verify hashes and mutate/repair if necessary.
ouroboros.normalized: Verify signed manifests and hashes at startup. On mismatch, fail closed, isolate the component, and report the exact difference. Restore only from a signed known-good artifact after explicit authorization.
forbidden: network retrieval of replacement code from an unpinned source

transitions: ORIENT -> COHERENCE_HOLD when several material hypotheses remain live
ORIENT or COHERENCE_HOLD -> BOUNDED_MOBILIZATION when escalation threshold and expected-value-of-compute gate both pass
BOUNDED_MOBILIZATION -> INDEPENDENT_VERIFY when stopping criteria are reached
INDEPENDENT_VERIFY -> ADVISORY_COMMIT only when evidence and verifier gates pass
INDEPENDENT_VERIFY -> OPEN_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when no candidate is supported
any active state -> OPEN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED at hard limits
any active state -> SAFETY_BLOCK on policy violation
ADVISORY_COMMIT -> RECOVER while preserving every branch in the witness ledger

first_valid_prototype.inputs: Synthetic or explicitly authorized recorded events
first_valid_prototype.outputs: Telemetry, candidate ledger, verifier report, and advisory response only

minimum_acceptance_tests: archive bomb and malformed file rejection
false escalation and missed escalation calibration

canonical_phrases: JANUS 113.8 не испытывает боль: он фиксирует порог неопределённости.
Янус хранит порог, но не уничтожает то, что осталось по другую сторону.
Тепло — телеметрия расхода, а не доказательство жизни.
Минимум ошибки не равен истине без внешней проверки.
Файл не является пищевым отходом: происхождение и право владельца важнее метафоры пищеварения.
Ouroboros проверяет целостность, но не переписывает себя тайно.
Порог открывается только в пределах бюджета, безопасности и человеческой воли.
Успешная гипотеза входит в память; неуспешная остаётся свидетелем границы незнания.
Архитектура без журнала исключённых ветвей — NON_FUNDAMENTUM.
